tools.name: find_destinations
tools.description: Finds the places Poplidays rents holiday homes in (towns, resorts, regions) from a name. Returns their id, needed by search_rentals.

tools.name: search_rentals
tools.description: Lists available holiday rentals in a destination for given dates and party, with the total price of the stay (mandatory fees included) and a link to book it.

tools.name: get_rental
tools.description: Describes one holiday rental: capacity, rooms, amenities, guest rating and latest reviews, location, indicative price per night and cancellation terms.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Prices a stay in one holiday rental for given dates and party: availability, total, discount, mandatory fees, cancellation terms, and the link to book it on the website.

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description: Returns the website link that opens the rental with the dates and party filled in, where the traveller checks the price and books. Nothing is reserved until they do.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Lists the stays that can be booked in one holiday rental (arrival, departure, nights) between two dates, without prices. Use get_quote or find_cheapest_stay to price them.

tools.name: find_cheapest_stay
tools.description: Prices the bookable stays of a given length in one rental between two dates and returns them cheapest first, with the link to book each. At most four stays are priced; when more exist, they are sampled evenly across the period.

tools.name: last_minute_deals
tools.description: Lists discounted rentals for a one-week stay starting next Saturday, optionally in one destination or by holiday theme, with the price of the week and a link to book it.

tools.name: compare_rentals
tools.description: Sets two to four holiday rentals side by side: capacity, rooms, surface, amenities, rating, location and indicative price per night.

tools.name: get_destination_guide
tools.description: Gives the Poplidays guide to a destination when one is written: overview and frequently asked questions (when to go, getting there, what to do).
